healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
description: Restores 20 HP of the drinker's lost health.

curing_potion.name: Curing Potion
description: A more powerful version of the Healing Potion,
restores 80 HP of the drinker's lost health.

restore_potion.name: Restore Potion
description: Restores full health to the drinker.

energy_potion.name: Energy Potion
description: Restores 20 SP of the drinker's lost energy.

endurance_potion.name: Endurance Potion
description: A more powerful version of the Energy Potion,
Restores 80 SP of the drinker's lost energy.

stamina_potion.name: Stamina Potion
description: Restores all energy to the drinker.

fire_flask.name: Fire Flask
description: A sticky, incendiary liquid that bursts into flame on contact with air.

inferno_flask.name: Inferno Flask
description: A more powerful version of the Fire Flask.
A sticky, incendiary liquid that bursts into flame on contact with air.

acid_flask.name: Acid Flask
description: This vicious fluid eats into the flesh of any creature it touches, doing continuous damage.

sleep_flask.name: Sleep Gas Flask
description: A liquid that vaporizes when exposed to air,
forming a gas that drains the mobility of those who breathe it.

antidote_potion.name: Antidote Potion
description: Halts the effects of poison, but does not restore damage already inflicted by poison.

protection_potion.name: Protection Potion
description: Temporarily increases the Protection of the drinker by 5 points during 1 battle.

intelligence_potion.name: Intelligence Potion
description: Temporarily increases the Intelligence of the drinker by 5 points during 1 battle.

willpower_potion.name: Willpower Potion
description: Temporarily increases the Willpower of the drinker by 5 points during 1 battle.

dexterity_potion.name: Dexterity Potion
description: Temporarily increases the Dexterity of the drinker by 5 points during 1 battle.

speed_potion.name: Speed Potion
description: Temporarily increases the Speed of the drinker by 5 points during 1 battle.

strength_potion.name: Strength Potion
description: Temporarily increases the Strength of the drinker by 5 points during 1 battle.

stealth_potion.name: Stealth Potion
description: Temporarily increases the Stealth rank of the drinker by 3 points during 1 battle.
